description: `prose --output json logs` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli run list --limit 1`.

problem.action: Use `cli run list`: `prose --output json cli run list --limit 1`.

details.reason: `logs` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli run list --limit 1`? `cli run watch RUN_ID` replays a run's events; `cli run list --limit 1` finds the latest run. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
